text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wait, did we have training today?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I'm sooooo sorry♪
I seriously totally forgot!?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Well, what's done is done!
Best not to sweat it too much~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Fusaichi Pandora completely unrepentant,
I gave her a firm warning so it wouldn't
affect her training.
